//: Local development of the admin API against the same DynamoDB the public API uses (DynamoDB Local or the
real dev table, see koleksi-backend/.env and CLAUDE.md section 4).
While the staff pool ids below read REPLACEME, a Debug build in the Development environment serves staff
sign-in from Development/LocalStaffIdentity.cs: one account, tokens signed by the process. That code is
compiled out of every Release build, and the host refuses to start with it if a stage name is set.
The account name is below. Its PASSWORD is deliberately not in this file (a secret must not sit in a tracked file):
set it once on your machine with
dotnet user-secrets set "KoleksiAdmin:LocalStaff:Password" "<any long random value>" --project src/Koleksi.AdminApi
The account exists only on this machine. It is not a real staff account.
